description: This file defines the LogFragment class, a UI component that displays log data using a LogView inside a ScrollView, with methods to initialize views and handle text changes.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that contains a LogView for displaying logs, with view initialization and text change handling.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, styles, and padding.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the views, sets up a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on text change, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance used within the fragment.
